# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My pick: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a pad for AirPods. The phone pad tilts and supports landscape and StandBy mode. It lists at $109, with WIRED showing about $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | Qi2 25W for the phone and a heavy, stable base. It has no power adapter, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's is $25). |
| Cheapest | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Charging Station | ~$40 (was $80) | Qi2-certified at 15W, with a charger and cable included. The Watch puck is detachable. |
| Sleek flat charging | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Qi2 25W. Flat pads can pop up for StandBy, but Watch charging is slow. |
| Travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | ~$80 (was $110) | Folds compact, 15W. |
| Fast travel and desk | Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W | $129.99 | Tallest and most adjustable foldable. It includes a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)) |
| Fast travel with a fan | ESR CryoBoost Qi2 25W | $100 | The fan can be switched off for sleeping. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)) |

## Which to choose
- **Overnight charging:** WIRED notes that 25W makes little difference when you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or the cheaper ESR is plenty. 25W only helps with iPhone 16 or 17 models, per Macworld.
- **Watch:** Fast Watch charging needs a Series 7 or newer.
- **AirPods:** The case must support wireless charging.

## Where to buy
- **ESR CryoBoost (Qi2.2 25W) with a discount:** Dealectric lists code **PARTNER18**, which it says took the price from $99.99 to about $82 in ESR's cart on Oct 25. Check the final price at checkout. This is an affiliate link that pays Dealectric, at no extra cost to you: [ESR CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/))
- **Belkin, Nomad, ESR budget, Nimble, Anker and Satechi:** I don't have verified direct purchase links for these. The retailer buttons (Amazon, Best Buy, Nomad, Apple) are in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) and [WIRED's travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/). Satechi's price and deal links are on its [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html).

Prices come from the articles and may have changed. Tell me your iPhone model and whether this is for a desk, nightstand or travel, and I can narrow it to one.
